notes.title: 🎮 Devlog #1 — First Step: Steam Page is Live!
notes.content:
[h1]🧩 Devlog #1 — First Step: Steam Page is Live![/h1]

Hello everyone!

Today, we want to share a small but very exciting development with you.  
Our horror game [b]Resfer[/b], which we've been working on for a long time, is now [b]on Steam![/b]

The game is not playable yet, but we will share the entire process with you through this page. We'll announce the story, mechanics, trailers, and our first playable demo here.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597630/Resfer__Who_is_there/ style=button]Steam Page[/url]

[h2]🆕 What’s in This Devlog?[/h2]


[*][b]Our Steam page is live![/b] Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist 🖤  
[*]We're actively working on the core concept and world of the game  
[*][b]6 new Steam achievements[/b] have been added! Get ready to unlock them 🏆  
[*]Pre-production for the first trailer has begun  
[*]Our social network is live to connect with the community


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550749/b5dc5ab959fdf707af00047abacf0a66e43fa107.png[/img]

[h2]🔮 What’s Next?[/h2]


[*]Concept art from development  
[*]Short insights about the story  
[*]And a teaser trailer… coming very soon 👀  




[h2]📌 Technical Details[/h2]

[tr]Build Version
[tr]0.1.0



[h2]🏅 About the New Achievements[/h2]

We've activated 6 brand new Steam achievements!  
These will be unlockable in the upcoming demo and full release.  
Some are based on exploration, others on moments that require courage.  
We wanted to leave a small challenge for collectors 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550749/a388753aafa5a8bf8b9641d4bf098cd93a668380.png[/img]

[h2]💬 Community & Feedback[/h2]

Share your comments, theories, and expectations with us!  
The community will be an integral part of this project.

[b]Our Social Media Accounts:[/b]  
[url=https://www.instagram.com/akugames/ style=button]Instagram[/url]  
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@akugamess style=button]TikTok[/url]  




Thank you,  
[b]See you in the next devlog![/b]  
[i]– Aku Games / The Resfer Team[/i]
